title: Pointwise noise operator on a monomial
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$, real $\rho$, subset $S\subseteq[n]$, and $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$, applying the noise operator with parameter $\rho$ to the monomial indexed by $S$ and evaluating at $x$ gives $\rho^{|S|}\prod_{i\in S}x_i$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a point of the $n$-dimensional sign cube
